Class Tower

java.lang.Object
models.base.Unit
models.base.Tower
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attackable
Direct Known Subclasses:
CatTower, DogTower
public class Tower extends Unit
Represents an immovable base structure (tower) for either side.

Towers are stationary targets with HP that never regenerates. When a tower's HP reaches 0 the game ends. Unlike regular units, towers remain in the battle lists at 0 HP so that attacking units continue to animate against the defeated tower until the game-over sequence fires.

    • isDead

      public boolean isDead()
      A tower is considered dead when its HP reaches 0, triggering the game-over sequence. Note: unlike regular units, the tower is NOT removed from the board immediately — the game loop handles the end-state.

      true when HP == 0
